test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the given expression.

sqrt (1 + cos P)/(1 - cos P)
solution:
**Given:**

sqrt (1 + cos P)/(1 - cos P)

**Concept used:**

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

1 - cos²θ = sin²θ

**Calculation:**

sqrt (1 + cos P)/(1 - cos P)

⇒ sqrt ((1 + cos P)times(1 + cos P))/((1 - cos P)times(1 + cos P)) 

⇒ sqrt ((1 + cos P)²)/(1 - cos² P) 

⇒ sqrt ((1 + cos P)²)/(sin² P) 

⇒ ((1 + cos P))/(sin P) 

⇒ (1)/(sin P) + (cos P)/(sin P) 

⇒ cosec P + cot P

**∴ The required answer is cosec P + cot P.**
